common.helpDescription: Need help? Click here anytime to start an interactive tutorial that will explain step by step how to use the current page.

welcome.title: Welcome to Smart Economat!
welcome.description: This is your central dashboard. From here you will have a global view of everything happening in the economat in real time.

navigation.title: Navigation Menu
navigation.description: Use the sidebar to move between different areas of the system. The menu adapts to your device.

stats.title: Economat Status
stats.description: Watch your most important KPIs: low stock, pending orders, and active incidences at a glance.

actions.title: Quick Actions
actions.description: Need to create an order or add a product? Access the most frequent functions without navigating through menus.

notifications.title: Notification Center
notifications.description: Watch critical system alerts: stock breaks, new pending users, or urgent discrepancies.

activity.title: Recent Activity
activity.description: Stay up to date with the history of stock movements and recently performed operations.

profile.title: Your Profile and Preferences
profile.description: Manage your personal data and notifications. You can also find this help here when you need it.

search.title: Smart Search
search.description: Type the name, brand, or barcode to locate products. You can even use the scanner!

filters.title: Advanced Filters
filters.description: Refine your search by selecting specific categories to find exactly what you need.

sort.title: Data Sorting
sort.description: Click on the column headers to sort the list ascending or descending.

add.title: Product Creation
add.description: Add new items to the catalog. The system will try to autocomplete data if you use the scanner.

export_pdf.title: PDF Export
export_pdf.description: Generate documents ready to print with the current list and its prices.

export_excel.title: Excel Reports
export_excel.description: Download all technical information to work on it externally.

row_actions.title: Quick Actions
row_actions.description: From here you can edit, delete, or restore products individually.

search.title: Provider Search
search.description: Find any provider by their name, NIF, contact person, or email.

sort.title: Smart Sorting
sort.description: Organize the list alphabetically by corporate name or by any other contact field.

add.title: Provider Registration
add.description: Add new providers to your catalog to manage their orders and products.

export_pdf.title: PDF Export
export_pdf.description: Generate a PDF document with the full list of your providers and their contact details.

export_excel.title: Excel Report
export_excel.description: Download the provider database for external analysis or administrative management.

row_actions.title: Individual Management
row_actions.description: Check detailed files, edit information, or delete providers directly from the row.

carousel.title: Culinary Inspiration
carousel.description: Explore our featured suggestions and seasonal dishes in this visual carousel.

search.title: Recipe Search
search.description: Find any dish by its name, ingredients, or even by its preparation steps.

sort.title: Agile Sorting
sort.description: Organize your recipe book by difficulty, preparation time, or name as you need.

add.title: Recipe Creation
add.description: Register new elaborations detailing ingredients, steps, and estimated costs.

cooking.title: Let's Cook!
cooking.description: Use the preparation button to launch productions instantly. You can also view complete technical data.

tabs.title: Order Center
tabs.description: Toggle between your personal orders, the global center list, or supplier purchase management.

add.title: New Order
add.description: Start an item request. The system allows you to search and add products quickly.

continue.title: Recover Drafts
continue.description: If you leave an order halfway, you can continue it here without losing the products you had already added.

flow.title: Flow Tracking
flow.description: Here you will see the status of each order (Pending, In Process, Received) and can manage its details.

export_pdf.title: PDF Control
export_pdf.description: Generate consolidated lists to review the period's purchasing needs.

export_excel.title: Excel Export
export_excel.description: Download all detailed information to work on it in external spreadsheets.

stepper.title: Reception Assistant
stepper.description: Follow these 4 guided steps to register incoming goods accurately and organized.

sync.title: Safe Draft
sync.description: Your progress is automatically synced to the cloud. You can start on a PC and finish on a Tablet without losing data.

search.title: Smart Reception
search.description: Scan the barcode or search by name to identify the products you are receiving.

scale.title: Scale Connectivity
scale.description: If you have a compatible scale, connect it via USB to capture weights automatically in real time.

nav.title: Process Steps
nav.description: Use the navigation buttons to move between order selection, counting, and final review.

tabs.title: Delivery Management
tabs.description: Toggle between orders ready to be delivered and the history of distributions made.

search.title: Quick Search
search.description: Locate specific deliveries by searching for order number, username, or destination classroom.

content.title: Pending List
content.description: Here you will see all products that have already been received in the warehouse and are waiting to be taken to their final destination.

distribute.title: Start Delivery
distribute.description: Click here to open the delivery assistant, where you can choose the destination location and the quantities to transfer.

confirm.title: Receipt Confirmation
confirm.description: Once the goods are delivered, the recipient must confirm receipt from the history to formalize the stock movement.

summary.title: Preparation Bag
summary.description: Here you manage everything that comes out of the kitchen. Control the stock of prepared dishes ready to serve or distribute.

tabs.title: Production Status
tabs.description: Toggle between currently available preparations and the history of those that have already run out.

consume.title: Consumption Record
consume.description: Use this button when you send portions to the dining room or make a delivery. The system will automatically discount the batch stock.

merma.title: Waste Management
merma.description: If a portion spoils or there is a service error, record it here to keep the inventory squared.

detail.title: Detailed Control
detail.description: Consult the technical sheet of the preparation, including real costs and expiration dates.

toolbar.title: Delivery Note Management
toolbar.description: In this section you can digitize and manage the delivery notes from your suppliers.

add.title: Manual Registration
add.description: Don't have the delivery note digitized? Create it manually here to link it later to your receptions.

upload.title: Digital Storage
upload.description: Upload a photo or PDF of the physical delivery note to always have the documentary backup a click away.

table.title: Consistency Control
table.description: Verify at a glance if the received goods match what is indicated on the supplier's paper.

view.title: History and Inquiry
view.description: Access the full detail to see what specific products came in this shipment.

toolbar.title: Inventory Management
toolbar.description: Here you can view and manage all stock available in the economat in a centralized way.

add.title: Stock Entry
add.description: Use this button to add products to the inventory manually if they don't come from a previous order.

locations.title: Warehouse Configuration
locations.description: Define and manage the shelves, chambers, and storage areas of your center.

search.title: Search and AI
search.description: Search for products by name or use the barcode scanner for much more agile management.

filters.title: Smart Filters
filters.description: Refine the list by product categories or by specific locations to find what you need.

tabs.title: Locations and Slots
tabs.description: Toggle between the global view and your assigned zones to see only what belongs to you.

table.title: Control Actions
table.description: From the table you can adjust stock due to waste or audit batches and expiration dates for each product.

toolbar.title: Movement History
toolbar.description: Every change in stock is recorded here: entries, exits, waste, and manual adjustments.

filters.title: Filtering by Type
filters.description: Search for specific movements by filtering by date or by type of operation (e.g., only waste or only entries).

table.title: Traceability
table.description: Check at a glance which user performed the action, which product was affected, and the exact quantity.

detail.title: Audit Details
detail.description: Access the full detail to see the affected batch and, if the movement comes from an order or distribution, go directly to its source.

toolbar.title: Waste Management
toolbar.description: From here you will control all unplanned stock losses in the inventory.

report.title: Report Waste
report.description: Record waste due to breakage, expiration, or theft. Remember that this action discounts stock permanently.

stats.title: Impact Statistics
stats.description: Consult at a glance the total volume of losses and the most frequent reasons to take action.

table.title: Waste History
table.description: All waste is audited. Review the history to see who reported the loss and the detailed reason.

toolbar.title: Incidence Center
toolbar.description: All discrepancies detected during the reception of goods are centralized here.

reports.title: Reports and Export
reports.description: Generate official lists in PDF or Excel for supplier claims or internal audits.

tabs.title: Filtering by Status
tabs.description: Organize your work by separating what is pending review from what has already been resolved.

table.title: Problem Traceability
table.description: Consult the detail of what was missing or what arrived extra in each order to make the right decision.

adjust.title: Discrepancy Adjustment
adjust.description: Correct the real quantities received if there was an error in the initial data collection.

resolve.title: Final Resolution
resolve.description: Upon resolving, the system will automatically adjust the inventory and close the discrepancy cycle.

header.title: Administración Académica
header.description: Desde este centro de control gestionarás la estructura organizativa del economato y los accesos al sistema.

tabs.title: Módulos de Gestión
tabs.description: Navega entre la gestión de aulas, el listado de alumnos vinculados, la administración de usuarios y las plantillas de roles.

users.title: Control de Usuarios
users.description: Administra cuentas, restablece contraseñas y asigna roles específicos a cada miembro del equipo.

slots.title: Modo Gestión
slots.description: Activa este modo para editar nombres de aulas, capacidades o asignar profesores a clases específicas.

user.title: User Profile
user.description: From this card you can review and edit your basic personal data.

security.title: Security and Password
security.description: You can change your username and password. Changing the email requires authorization from a higher role.

nav.title: Navigation
nav.description: Use the sidebar to move between different sections assigned to your role.

account.title: Your Account
account.description: Manage your profile, theme preferences, and log out from the top menu.
